title: Rooted Innkeeper

steps.prompt: A warm middle-aged village innkeeper with rolled sleeves, a patched apron, a wooden ladle on the belt, kind smile, earthy clothes in cream, tan and leaf green. Full-body character design, one person standing in a relaxed A-pose facing the viewer, whole body in frame from head to feet, plain flat white background, even lighting, anime proportions about seven heads tall, slightly large hands. High-end anime fantasy RPG key visual, stylised 3D look with painterly textures, soft cel shading with warm bounce light and cool rim light, detailed ornate equipment with engraved metal, layered cloth and leather, realistic proportions, expressive anime faces, lush bright colours with luminous highlights, original design, no photorealism, no text, no watermark, no logo.

steps.version: trellis_2_bf16 with shape and texture VAEs and dino_v3_vit_l (Comfy-Org/TRELLIS.2), BiRefNet background removal inside the workflow, ComfyUI 0.39.0 built-in nodes

cleanup: Automatic only, by tools/pipeline/blender_finish_model.py: stood upright, welded, decimated to 25000 triangles, smart UV unwrap, vertex colours baked to a 2048 px texture, scaled so the longest side is 1.75 m, origin at the centre of the base.
